g.text: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer, DevBridge · South Africa

text.tspan: Cloud infrastructure and DevOps engineer. I build and run production Django systems on AWS, and I'm certified in AWS, CompTIA and
Azure. I write up what I learn in a public Knowledge Hub and build small open-source tools, including a self-hosted network monitor
